headline: Aselsan Order Backlog Exceeds $30 Billion
summary: Turkish defense company Aselsan reported that its order backlog surpassed $30 billion at the end of September as it expanded production capacity.
why: Large order backlogs provide visibility into future revenue streams and earnings growth for major defense contractors.

impacts.name: Aselsan
impacts.why: An expanding order backlog exceeding $30 billion strengthens medium-term revenue visibility and operational scale.
